create_cmake_defines_option: create a builder option to set CMake defines for BUILD_QUIC, BUILD_SHARED_LIBS, and BUILD_TESTS
review_fbcode_builder_spec: review the fbcode_builder_spec function to understand proxygen build dependencies and CMake install steps
refactor_build_dependencies: refactor the fbcode_builder_spec to add or remove dependencies like gmock, fmt, folly, fizz, sodium, zstd, or mvfst
